answer: The anchor schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the wharf checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 22 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Someone wanting 102 effective identities must lock that capital for 22 epochs and keep it locked through every saffron audit. That is 36 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
